reviews.text: They're the best, always attentive to my dog ​​and cat, they care and look out for the best for our pets. I would recommend them without hesitation.
Professional and attentive. I don't live in the area, but I travel there so they can care for my cats. Thank you.

The staff were incredibly friendly. They came to register my dog's microchip and there were no problems at all. It was very quick, the service was excellent, and the prices were good. I'll definitely be back.

Excellent clinic! They helped us with my dog's travel documents, were very attentive throughout the entire process, and the support and kindness of the staff was outstanding. I'm very grateful for their support and great care, and we will definitely be back!
I was looking for food for my pet

Incredible experience. You can tell from the moment you walk in that they love animals. My dog ​​(an extra-large American Bully, quite strong) was treated with so much love, patience, and control, which gave me enormous peace of mind. Very professional, friendly, and honest. 100% recommended.

The service from the person working at the vet today, Saturday, September 6, 2025, was appalling. She refused to sell me one strip of omega-3 because my dog ​​is no longer registered as a client since we now live in Malaga. However, she was treated there from birth until she was six years old. And that's not all; the real outrage is that 15 days ago, this same vet sold me the omega-3 strip without asking me anything at all. I followed Hector since he worked at the Valverde clinic, and then I was a client of Hector and Bea, who are lovely, until three years ago when I moved. Since my dog ​​was there for a few days, I asked my father to take her to the clinic where I've always trusted my animals, but honestly, the service from that woman today was deplorable.

Besides sharing our story, I want to thank the entire veterinary team, and especially our veterinarian Bea and our guardian angel Leti. My dog ​​has been unwell since birth, with multiple environmental and food allergies, and since he was a 3-month-old puppy, we've been to countless veterinary clinics without any of them even trying to diagnose what was wrong with him. Since he was a puppy, with each digestive episode, which got worse over time, my dog ​​has been given corticosteroids, all kinds of antibiotics, and even B12 injections for no reason. I've lost count of the tests we've had (three allergy tests, four ultrasounds, incomplete blood work...). And believe me, the clinics we've been to were supposedly specialized in gastroenterology. We arrived at the clinic seeking their help with a misdiagnosis of pancreatitis and during the worst digestive crisis my dog ​​has ever experienced. Not only did they listen to us, but we finally have the best team we could have by our side, all wanting to find the best way to give my dog ​​a good quality of life. They want to understand him so they can treat him with all their knowledge and incredible support. Thank you so much, because on the road ahead, we're no longer alone. This morning at the clinic, the little guy came in greeting us happily, just like he does at home: they're the wisest when it comes to knowing who's truly there for them.
We've been taking Pepe and Manolo here since they were little. Excellent professionals.

I feel like they saved my dog's life today. I arrived almost at closing time, and luckily they decided to help me. If it weren't for the women who work there, my dog ​​might be in a very dangerous situation right now. I'm so grateful.
They're excellent professionals, located in the city center, and their prices are reasonable for the service they provide. I trust them to take my kittens there.
Very professional and attentive to your colleagues
We've been taking our husky there since he was a puppy and he loves it! Professional and trustworthy!
I took my pet for rehabilitation. Laser treatment and massages worked very well for him.

A TERRIBLE and dangerous experience for my dog.

I took him to the Chueca veterinary clinic, which, along with this one in Malasaña, belongs to the same owners.

Without running any tests, without an x-ray, and without even properly examining his mouth, they told me he needed urgent surgery to extract several teeth. Without hesitation, they gave me a quote of €300 for the operation, in addition to what I had already paid for the consultation, medication, and blood work.

Something didn't add up, so I sought a second opinion from another veterinarian. The result? No extractions were necessary, just a dental cleaning!

My dog ​​was almost subjected to invasive and unjustified surgery because of a completely erroneous diagnosis!

This isn't a simple mistake; it's a serious lack of professionalism and ethics that could have jeopardized my pet's health.

You can't play with animals' lives like this for money. If you value your pet's health, stay away from this place!
